SELECT ts.id AS seatId, tss_a.sequence AS startSequence, tss_b.sequence AS endSequence FROM seat_class sc INNER JOIN train_seat_class tsc ON sc.id = tsc.seat_class_id INNER JOIN train_stop_station tss_a ON tsc.train_id = tss_a.train_id INNER JOIN train_stop_station tss_b ON tss_a.train_id = tss_b.train_id INNER JOIN station s_start ON tss_a.station_id = s_start.id INNER JOIN station s_end ON tss_b.station_id = s_end.id INNER JOIN train_seat ts ON tsc.id = ts.train_seat_class_id
(tsc.train_id, sc.type, tsc.carriage_number, ts.seat_no, s_start.code, s_end.code) IN
( #{item.trainId}, #{item.seatType}, #{item.carriageNumber}, #{item.seatNo}, #{item.departureCode}, #{item.arrivalCode} )
AND tss_a.sequence < tss_b.sequence
